verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs describe Document AI as a parameter-driven API. They cover OCR request parameters (table_format, extract_header/extract_footer, include_blocks, confidence_scores_granularity), input methods (URL, Base64, upload) and annotation formats, and Mistral offers official Python and TypeScript SDKs. Community users report driving it programmatically, including chunking a 900-page job after a timeout. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and explicit endpoint/authentication reference documentation in the evidence.
